title: Personal Training Packages: free trainer-reassignment allowance and fee by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier, how many trainer reassignments on a package are free and the flat fee that applies to a reassignment beyond that free allowance. Which reassignments count toward the free allowance, and how any corporate wellness discount reduces a chargeable fee, are stated in the trainer reassignment policy and corporate-wellness-discount-on-a-reassignment-fee documents, not here.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Free reassignments per package | Fee for each reassignment beyond the free allowance (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | 1 | 0.00 |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | 1 | 0.00 |
| 10-Session Value Pack | 2 | 0.00 |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | 2 | 0.00 |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | 2 | 0.00 |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | 1 | 30.00 |

## Points of reference
Elite Specialty Coaching is the only tier of Personal Training Packages that lists a nonzero fee for a reassignment beyond its free allowance, and it also allows the fewest free reassignments, at 1. The 10-Session Value Pack, 20-Session Performance Pack, and Unlimited Monthly Coaching each allow 2 free reassignments per package, the largest allowance among the tiers shown.
